```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")
numeric = df.select_dtypes(include="number")
time_columns = [c for c in df.columns if any(token in c.lower() for token in ("date", "time", "year", "period"))]
display(Markdown(f"<div class='summary-grid'><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Rows</span><span class='value'>{len(df):,}</span></div><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Columns</span><span class='value'>{len(df.columns)}</span></div><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Numeric measures</span><span class='value'>{len(numeric)}</span></div></div>\n\n**Input:** `{SOURCE_FILENAME}`"))
```

## Public-health view

This report gives a concise overview of the uploaded table. It highlights the size of the dataset, missing values, numeric ranges, important categories, and any visible time pattern.

## What is in the file?

```{python}
quality = pd.DataFrame({
    "field": df.columns,
    "data type": [str(df[c].dtype) for c in df.columns],
    "missing values": [int(df[c].isna().sum()) for c in df.columns],
    "different values": [int(df[c].nunique(dropna=True)) for c in df.columns],
})
display(quality)
```

## Main numeric findings

```{python}
if numeric.empty:
    display(Markdown("No numeric measures were detected in this table."))
else:
    findings = numeric.agg(["count", "mean", "min", "max"]).transpose().round(2)
    display(findings)
```

## Time pattern

```{python}
if not time_columns:
    display(Markdown("No time field was detected, so this is presented as a snapshot."))
else:
    display(Markdown("Time-like field(s): " + ", ".join(f"`{c}`" for c in time_columns)))
    for column in time_columns:
        parsed = pd.to_datetime(df[column], errors="coerce")
        if parsed.notna().mean() >= 0.8:
            display(df.assign(_time=parsed).groupby("_time")[list(numeric.columns)].sum().tail(20) if not numeric.empty else df[column].value_counts().head(20))
```

## Data preview

```{python}
display(df.head(20))
```

## Important limitation

This is an automatic descriptive report. It does not establish disease thresholds, risk, causation, or public-health recommendations. Interpret the results using the source context and data-quality information.
